nodes.summary: Let $A$, $B$, $C$ be discrete valuation rings, with $B$ and $C$ algebras over $A$, where $C$ is finite as an $A$-module and the structure map $A \to C$ is a local homomorphism. Then every $A$-algebra homomorphism $B \to C$ is a local homomorphism.
nodes.title: Algebra maps from a DVR into a finite local DVR extension are local

nodes.summary: Let $A$, $B$, $C$ be discrete valuation rings, with $B$ and $C$ algebras over $A$ whose structure maps are local homomorphisms, where $C$ is finite as an $A$-module and $B$ is formally unramified over $A$. Write $\kappa(R)$ for the residue field of a local ring $R$. Then two $A$-algebra homomorphisms $B \to C$ that induce the same $\kappa(A)$-algebra homomorphism $\kappa(B) \to \kappa(C)$ are equal.
nodes.title: Residue-field maps determine algebra maps out of a formally unramified DVR extension

nodes.summary: Let $A$, $B$, $C$ be discrete valuation rings, with $B$ and $C$ algebras over $A$ whose structure maps are local homomorphisms, where $C$ is finite as an $A$-module. Write $\kappa(R)$ for the residue field of a local ring $R$. An $A$-algebra homomorphism $f \colon B \to C$ induces the $\kappa(A)$-algebra homomorphism $\kappa(B) \to \kappa(C)$ that sends the residue class of $b \in B$ to the residue class of $f(b)$.
nodes.title: Induced map on residue fields of DVR extensions
